flows.name: Replan Cooking with shopping quantities
steps: Load the Profession Planner release package with ForeverCore 1.15.6 and reload the WoW client.
Open the Cooking route at skill 272 and goal 300. Click Replan and open the shopping list.
Verify that the route still plans 38 crafts and both views ask for 76 Hot Spices and 38 Raw Summer Bass.

flows.name: Keep the route and open shopping list in sync when the goal changes
steps: Set the Cooking goal to 280 while the shopping list is open.
Verify that the route changes to 8 crafts and both views ask for 16 Hot Spices and 8 Raw Summer Bass.
Restore the original goal of 300. Verify that both views immediately restore the original quantities.
